preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 3.
The number of old cities K must be at least 2 and at most N, which is at most 100,000.
The number of newer roads M must be between 0 and 100,000.
The starting city S must be a valid city number between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= N and 1 <= b_i <= N and 1 <= c_i <= 10**9 for a_i, b_i, c_i in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect valid cities and have a valid length.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly N distances.
The distance from city S to itself must be 0.
